products.name: GoGuardian Beacon
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Machine-learning classifier on browsing, search, email, apps. Use: Suicide and self-harm alerting on school devices. Who: District administrators, counselors. Student age: School-issued devices of enrolled students. Privacy: District contract; school staff decide on every alert; optional 24/7 human specialist tier. profile_text.body:
GoGuardian describes itself as a company that empowers K-12 leaders with tools for safe and engaging learning, and says it helps over 70% of top districts. On its own site it presents AI-driven detection that spots warning signs of self-harm or violence so staff can assess risk and act, and states that it has spent a decade delivering solutions for districts at different points in their AI adoption. It says its AI systems are aligned with educational objectives, prioritize student well-being, and build privacy and data protection into development and deployment.

The product tracked for GoGuardian is GoGuardian Beacon, listed under Education and Research AI. It is described as a machine-learning classifier that works on browsing, search, email, and apps to alert on suicide and self-harm on school devices, used by district administrators and counselors for the school-issued devices of enrolled students. Its privacy basis is a district contract, with school staff deciding on every alert and an optional 24/7 human specialist tier. Pricing is listed in tiers: Beacon Starter, announced free with GoGuardian Admin in 2020, Core, and 24/7, with current pricing to be confirmed by quote; the free Starter tier dates from that 2020 announcement.
